repaired_proposal.title: Index, EXPLAIN, query rewrite, and keyset pagination
repaired_proposal.summary: Index supports the query access path. EXPLAIN shows the execution plan. Query rewrite changes the query form, and keyset pagination uses a stable cursor.
notes: Index：Index supports the query access path. Practical application: enterprise systems can evaluate high frequency query paths. Trade-off: read performance and write maintenance cost are trade-offs.
EXPLAIN：EXPLAIN shows the execution plan. Release checks can inspect the plan with representative data.
Query rewrite：Query rewrite changes the query form. Practical application: backend systems inspect the query form.
Keyset pagination：Keyset pagination uses a stable cursor. The access path and cursor behavior are relevant in system design.
